questions.prompt: In pd.DataFrame({"score": [92, 88]}), what does the key become?
questions.explain: A DataFrame is a dictionary of columns, so the keys are the column names.

questions.prompt: Which are worth doing before you summarise a table?
questions.explain: Two lines that catch a wrong separator, a missing header and a numeric column read as text.

questions.prompt: You expected six columns and shape says (1000, 1). What happened?
choices: The separator was wrong, so each line became one value
questions.explain: Every line arrived as a single unsplit string. The shape said so before any of the values did.
